info.title: WhatsApp REST API
info.description: Multi-session REST API gateway for WhatsApp Web client

get.description: Returns connection status and stream information.
Returns all consumers for the specified stream.

post.description: Removes all messages from the specified stream.

parameters.name: stream_name
parameters.description: Stream name to purge (e.g., WA_EVENTS or WA_SEND)

400.description: Invalid caller JID or empty call_id
Invalid peer JID or empty call_id

get.summary:
Paginated dump of locally-cached contacts for a session. Contacts are
upserted automatically from appstate sync mutations, push-name updates,
contact-notification stanzas, and inbound messages — no separate sync
call required.

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: Reset and generate new invite link

post.summary:
Manually flip a webhook row back to enabled=true after the auto-disable
circuit muted it. Used by operators once the downstream target has
been fixed. Also clears `disabled_at` / `disabled_reason` so the
listing reflects the recovered state.

AcceptCallRequest.description:
Accept an incoming call via `client.voip().accept(&incoming)`. If
`text` or `audio_url` is supplied, the accepted call also plays that
audio to the caller after `answer_grace_ms` of silent padding, then
hangs up. Both silent by default.

answer_grace_ms.description: Silent padding before playback starts. Defaults to 1500 ms.

audio_url.description: Optional audio URL to play to the caller once accepted (mp3/wav/ogg).

text.description: Optional TTS text to speak to the caller once accepted.

voice.description: edge-tts voice id when `text` is set. Defaults to `id-ID-ArdiNeural`.

request_message_id.description: Message ID of the payment request to cancel

ConnectRequest.description: Request to start QR connect with optional device override

oneOf.description: Optional per-session device props override (first-pair only)

CreateSessionRequest.description: Request to create a new session

oneOf.description:
Optional device props override applied to the auto-spawned QR connect.
Only honored on the first pair — subsequent connects reuse persisted props.

id.description: Optional custom session ID (auto-generated if not provided)

name.description: Optional friendly name for the session

oneOf.description: Optional webhook configuration (session will auto-connect after creation)

request_message_id.description: Message ID of the payment request to decline

DevicePropsRequest.description:
Optional per-session device identity override. Only honored on the
FIRST pair (connect/pair endpoints) — subsequent connects reuse the
props stored by whatsapp-rust at pairing time.

os.description: OS string shown in WhatsApp Linked Devices (e.g. "Windows", "Mac OS X")

platform.description:
Platform: desktop, uwp, chrome, firefox, edge, safari, opera, ie,
ipad, android_phone, android_tablet, ios_phone

version.description: Dotted app version (e.g. "2.3000.1023902713"). Omit to use lib default.

FakeReplyConfig.description:
Fake reply config — makes the outgoing message look like it's replying to a
fictional previous message from a random JID. Used for blast to appear more
natural / human-like.

type.description: text | product | order | location | video | document | contact

skip.description: Set to true to skip history sync

doc_name.description: GraphQL document name. Optional — defaults to "WAWebMexCustomMutation".

GraphQL document name (e.g. "WAWebMexListSubscribedNewslettersJobQuery").
Optional — defaults to "WAWebMexCustomQuery" if omitted. WhatsApp's
server matches on name + id, so set both to a known pair from
`wacore::iq::mex_ids` when in doubt.

NatsStatusResponse.description: NATS status response for the REST endpoint.

NatsStreamInfo.description: Stream information for NATS status endpoint.

PairCodeRequest.description: Request to connect with pair code

oneOf.description: Optional per-session device props override (first-pair only)

show_push_notification.description: Whether to show push notification on phone

PairStatus.description:
Pair-flow telemetry — surfaced through /status so the backend can
render meaningful progress instead of polling /qr blindly.

PlayCallRequest.description:
Ring a peer and play back an audio file (mp3, wav, ogg — anything ffmpeg
can decode) once the media relay is up. Terminates the call after the
last PCM chunk is flushed.

answer_grace_ms.description:
Grace period in ms before playback starts, giving the peer time to
answer. Defaults to 4000 ms.

audio_url.description:
URL of the audio file to fetch and play. Must be reachable from the
waxum process. Any format ffmpeg can demux (mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, opus).

qr_codes.description: QR code data (can be rendered as QR code image)

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds before QR code expires

id.description: Internal ID returned to your webhook when the user taps the button.

RingCallRequest.description:
Send a signalling-only ring to a recipient.

The upstream `whatsapp-rust` client has no media stack (opus/RTP), so
this endpoint sends only the `<call><offer>` signalling stanza. The
recipient's WhatsApp phone will ring for the usual timeout, then drop
with "call not connected" once no audio flow follows. Useful for
number verification, missed-call triggers, or attention pings.

call_id.description:
Optional custom `call-id`. If omitted a UUIDv4 is generated. Return
it back to the caller so they can later `POST /calls/reject`.

kind.description:
Call kind: `"audio"` (default) or `"video"`. Video adds a `<video>`
codec child so the peer's phone shows the video-call incoming UI.

to.description:
Recipient. Bare phone number ("6285117822731") or full JID
("6285117822731@s.whatsapp.net"). LID is not supported.

selected_display_text.description: Display text of the selected button

target_chat_jid.description:
Optional override for the chat JID embedded in the target key. Defaults
to `to` when omitted.

target_message_id.description: Message ID of the post being commented on

target_participant.description:
Optional author JID of the parent post. For encrypted CAG comments the
receivers key decryption off this field; if omitted the lib resolves
it from the locally-stored message secret.

text.description: The text content of the comment

to.description:
JID of the channel / community-announce group the comment lives in
(the same `chat` JID where the parent post was published).

body_text.description:
Body text shown between the header and the button. Optional —
when omitted (or set to `""`) the interactive block skips the
body line and the message becomes header + button only.

display_text.description: Visible label on the button (e.g. "Open website").

footer_text.description: Optional footer text shown beneath the body.

header_text.description:
Optional header title rendered *above* the body — the bold line
at the top of the interactive block. When omitted, the header
falls back to `display_text` (the button label) so the layout
still has a header line. Set this explicitly when the button
label and the eye-catcher should say different things (e.g.
button = "Shop now", header = "Ramadan drop is live").

oneOf.description:
Optional image to show above the CTA body. Accepts either an
`{ "url": "https://…" }` or `{ "data": "<base64>", "mimetype": "image/jpeg" }`
object. When set, waxum uploads the image to WhatsApp and
attaches it as the interactive header media, so the button
appears with an image thumbnail on the recipient side.

merchant_url.description:
Optional merchant URL — falls back to `url` when omitted. Some
clients show this in the link preview UI.

oneOf.description:
Optional fake-reply quoted message context. Adds a fabricated "quoted"
header above the message — some consumer WhatsApp builds only render
native_flow buttons as clickable when wrapped in a quoted context.

view_once.description:
Wrap the interactive payload in `viewOnceMessageV2`. Empirically the
only reliable way to get native_flow quick-reply buttons clickable on
consumer WhatsApp accounts (unverified business). Defaults to true.

version.description: Version of the native flow response

server_message_id.description: Server message ID from the newsletter

request_message_id.description: Message ID of the payment request being responded to

duration_seconds.description: Pin duration in seconds (0 to unpin, 86400 for 24h, 604800 for 7d, 2592000 for 30d)

selectable_count.description: Max number of selectable options (0 = unlimited)

poll_message_id.description: The message ID of the poll creation message

selected_options.description: Selected option hashes (SHA-256 of option text)

buttons.description: 1-3 reply buttons. WhatsApp clients clip beyond 3.

SendResult.description:
Result of processing an outbound command.
Published to `wa.events.{session_id}.send_result`.

scheduled_call_message_id.description: Message ID of the scheduled call creation message

scheduled_timestamp_ms.description: Scheduled call time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds

pair.description: Pair flow telemetry (always present, fields may be null)

oneOf.description: Who can edit group invite link
Membership approval mode for join requests

from_jid.description: The JID of the message sender

group_jid.description: For group reports, the group JID

group_subject.description: For group reports, the group subject/name

participant_jid.description: For group messages, the participant JID

jids.description: List of JIDs to issue tokens for

TerminateCallRequest.description: End a call the session is currently in.

peer.description: Peer JID (caller for incoming, callee for outgoing).

reason.description:
Optional termination reason string (e.g. "hangup", "busy"). Sent as
the `reason` attr on the `<terminate>` child. Defaults to
`"hangup"` when omitted.

TtsCallRequest.description:
Ring a peer and, once the media relay is up, speak `text` at them via
`edge-tts` (Microsoft Neural voices, free). Terminates the call after
the last PCM chunk is flushed.

answer_grace_ms.description:
Grace period in milliseconds to wait before the first PCM chunk is
pushed, giving the peer a moment to answer. Defaults to 4000 ms.

record.description:
If true, waxum decodes the peer's incoming MLOW frames back to
16 kHz mono PCM and writes them as a WAV file under
`{WHATSAPP_STORAGE_PATH}/{session_id}/recordings/{call_id}.wav`.
The file is served over
`GET /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/calls/{call_id}/recording.wav`
once the call ends. Defaults to `false`.

voice.description:
edge-tts voice id. Defaults to `id-ID-ArdiNeural` (male Indonesian).
See `edge-tts --list-voices` for the full list.

WebhookConfigWithId.description:
A webhook config bundled with its runtime ID so clients can call the
`DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id}` endpoint.

webhooks.description: List of webhooks, each with its ID so clients can DELETE by ID.

events.description: Events to subscribe to (defaults to all if not provided)

secret.description: Optional secret for HMAC signature verification

bearer_auth.description: Enter your Superadmin Token from server logs
